title: Sr. Software Engineer (Integrations)
description:

Dialpad is the AI platform for customer experience, built to resolve customer problems in real time across voice and digital. Our AI agents learn from your best human agents and improve with every interaction, helping organizations understand their customers, deliver better experiences, increase operational efficiencies, and build a lasting competitive advantage.
  
  
Unlike legacy systems built to route and answer, or standalone agentic bot vendors built to deflect, Dialpad was built to resolve. Our AI agents and human agents operate on a single platform with shared context, allowing Agentic AI to resolve issues, advance deals, and eliminate busywork through automation while seamlessly handing conversations to humans when needed, with full context preserved.
  
  
Market-leading brands, including Randstad, Motorola Solutions, Netflix, the San Diego Padres, the Colorado Rockies Baseball Club, and Cal Athletics, trust Dialpad. Dialpad is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, GV, ICONIQ Capital, and T-Mobile.

At Dialpad, AI isn’t just a feature; it’s how our teams do their best work every day. We put powerful AI tools in every employee’s hands so they can move faster, think bigger, and achieve more.
  
  
We believe every conversation matters. And we’ve built the platform that turns those conversations into insight and action, for our customers and ourselves.
  
  
We look for people who are intensely curious and hold themselves to a high bar. Our ambition is significant, and achieving it requires a team that operates at the highest level. We seek individuals who embody our core traits:
**Scrappy, Curious, Optimistic, Persistent, and Empathetic**
.
  
  
**Your role**
As a Sr. Software Engineer on the Integrations team, you will lead the design and development of Dialpad’s key native integrations. These integrations enable real-time automation and data transfer between Dialpad and complementary systems, ensuring our mutual customers have a seamless, unified experience. This includes Agentic AI-compatible integrations, CRMs, ticketing systems, workforce management platforms, and industry-specific verticals such as recruiting, retail, and healthcare.
  
  
You will own a functional area or set of related features within Integrations, translating customer and business needs into robust technical solutions. You will help shape the 6-12 month technical direction for your area, break down larger projects into clear deliverables, and solve classes of problems through shared tools, patterns, and processes.
  
  
You’ll collaborate closely with engineering teammates, product leaders, business leaders, Dialpad customers, and external stakeholders. You will be expected to operate with little guidance, make pragmatic business and technical tradeoffs, and mentor other engineers through design, implementation, code review, debugging, and production support.
  
  
This position reports to our Engineering Manager and has the opportunity to be based in our Bangalore office. The position will require a hybrid working arrangement based out of our Bangalore office.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the technical design, development, maintenance, and reliability of key native integrations across Dialpad’s Integrations platform.
* Build and enhance integrations with systems such as Zendesk, HubSpot, AthenaHealth, Salesforce, Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace, and other customer-critical SaaS platforms.

* Write architectural design and specification documents that clearly describe implementation options, tradeoffs, dependencies, risks, rollout plans, and success metrics.
* Develop backend services, APIs, workers, webhooks, data transfer flows, UI components, and automation workflows that scale across a large customer base.
* Break down larger projects into smaller deliverables and take responsibility for execution, delivery milestones, and the end-to-end result.
* Develop well-tested features with appropriate test hooks, monitoring, and alerting, resulting in low defect reports and healthier customer scenarios.
* Design for performance, reliability, debuggability, extensibility, security, privacy, and operational simplicity.
* Debug complex production issues across Dialpad services and third-party platforms, then turn those learnings into durable fixes and better team processes.
* Write clean, modular, and maintainable code using best practices along with unit tests.
* Participate in code and design reviews to ensure quality, maintainability, and scalability.
* Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers.
* Assist with emerging Agentic AI technologies and initiatives.
* Tech Stack: Python, Vue.js, Redis, Google Cloud, AI (MCP).

**Skills You’ll Bring**

* 7+ years of professional experience as a software engineer, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience owning significant backend, full-stack, platform, or integration systems in production, including design, implementation, launch, monitoring, and maintenance.
* Experience with at least one object-oriented programming language, especially Python or JavaScript.
* Experience building integrations, APIs, webhooks, event-driven systems, distributed systems, or customer-facing platform features.
* Strong testing, debugging, and troubleshooting skills, especially across distributed systems and third-party platform boundaries.
* Experience with OAuth, permission models, API rate limits, webhooks, event delivery, retries, idempotency, and third-party platform constraints.
* Experience with Agile development methodologies.
* Effective communication skills, including writing design documents, surfacing risks early, and keeping stakeholders aligned.

* Agentic AI experience or strong interest in building AI-compatible product workflows.
* Usage of AI coding assistants such as Claude, Gemini, or similar tools for the majority of coding tasks.

**Why Join Dialpad**

* Work at the center of the AI transformation in business communications
* Build and ship agentic AI products that are redefining how companies operate
* Join a team where AI amplifies every employee’s impact
* Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and real opportunities for growth

* Envoy or NGINX expertise
* Multi‑region traffic management (Global Accelerator/CloudFront), resilience patterns, and DR playbooks.
* Data stores for counters and policies (Redis/KeyDB, DynamoDB including Global Tables).
* Observability stacks (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki/ELK) and SLO/error budget practices.

description:
ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast.
  
  
**Title:**
Software Engineer II, Full-Stack Engineer
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Ship user-facing features end to end — schema and endpoint through to the screen, the empty state, the loading state, and the error someone will actually hit.
* Turn a loosely worded request into a written spec precise enough that an agent, or a new teammate, can build from it without guessing.
* Review hard. Your own pull requests, your teammates', and the ones an agent opened. Catching a plausible-looking mistake before it merges is the highest-value hour of your week.
* Write tests that would genuinely fail if the feature broke, and verify the change in the running product rather than trusting a green checkmark.
* Work inside conventions the repository already encodes — house rules, lint rules, coverage thresholds, component patterns — and improve those conventions when they turn out to be wrong.
* Roll changes out behind feature flags and watch what monitoring says afterwards.
* Pick up whatever is in front of the team. Priorities here move; a bug in a service you have never opened is still yours if it is the most useful thing to fix.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–5 years building and shipping production web software that real users depended on.
* Strong TypeScript. You use types to catch mistakes before they reach production, not just to keep the compiler quiet. You can work out what an unfamiliar type is describing, write one that matches the real shape of your data, and recognise when a simpler type would do the same job.
* Real React depth. Component composition, where state should live, why something re-rendered, and how to test a component the way a user meets it.
* Enough server-side experience to be useful on day one in NestJS or a comparable framework: dependency injection, request validation, REST design, and talking to a database, a cache and a queue.
* You have worked in a large shared codebase and can find your way around unfamiliar code without waiting for a tour.
* You have used AI coding agents on real work and have opinions about where they fail.
* Clear written English. Specifications, pull request descriptions, review comments. In this workflow, writing is load-bearing rather than a soft skill.
* Comfortable being told the priority changed — and able to put down something half-finished cleanly.

**Nice to have**

* Nx, Turborepo or another monorepo toolchain.
* Data-dense interfaces: virtualised or enterprise data grids, charting, filter builders.

This is a highly technical role for an expert who bridges the gap between High-Performance Computing (HPC) and Big Data systems engineering and low-latency machine learning infrastructure and involves database internals, distributed systems, performance engineering, data processing at scale.
  
  
In this role, you will be one of the primary designers and developer responsible for building low-latency, high-throughput distributed database kernels. You will design bare-metal optimized software layers, ensuring our database product fully exploits modern multi-core, vectorized hardware and distributed network fabrics to process terabyte/petabyte-scale datasets and where appropriate, seamlessly executes highly performant analytics and in-database ML inference directly on relational and the occasional vector datasets.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

* Architecture & Design: Play a key role in core architectural choices and roadmap for our distributed database kernel, including query execution engines, custom/hybrid columnar storage layers, distributed transaction managers, and cluster coordination protocols.
* Low-Level Development: Write, optimize, and maintain highly performant, production-ready backend code utilizing modern C++ (C++20/23).
* Parallel Execution Planning: Architect MPP execution engines that distribute, schedule, and execute queries across several dozens to hundreds of nodes using MPI and hybrid OpenMP models.
* Hardware Optimization: Profile and eliminate execution bottlenecks by implementing explicit SIMD vectorization (AVX-512, ARM Neon, SVE) and ensuring absolute cache locality (L1/L2/L3).
* Distributed Memory & Networks: Design ultra-low latency cluster communication subsystems utilizing RDMA, RoCE, or kernel-bypass tech (DPDK).
* In-Database ML Framework Design: Architect and implement a native, highly performant, zero-copy ML execution framework directly inside the MPP engine to eliminate data serialization and transport bottlenecks between the database and external AI pipelines.
* Functional & High-Performance Algorithms: Develop mathematically rigorous, cache-oblivious, and highly vectorized algorithms for real-time statistical computations, matrix operations/manipulations on clustered data
* Vector & Embedding Infrastructure: Design and optimize or embed/reference distributed high-dimensional vector storage subsystems, custom SIMD-accelerated indexing structures (e.g., HNSW, IVF-PQ), and parallelized approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms.
* Be comfortable working in a cross country/multi time zone team of elite systems engineers, implementing as well as conducting rigorous peer design and development reviews
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams in defining and developing new platform capabilities.
* Actively participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical mentoring.
* Investigate and resolve complex performance and scalability issues.

* Minimum - 4 years Computer Science engineering degree from a reputed institute. Masters in HPC (high performance computing) and Bigdata engineering areas preferred for Senior staff engineer and above roles
* Modern C++ Expertise: 6+ years of production experience writing hands-on, low-level systems in C++ (C++17/20/23 preferred). Mastery of template metaprogramming, concepts, coroutines, and custom memory allocators is key.
* HPC Parallelism: Very good to expert-level knowledge of cluster-scale distributed programming using MPI (Message Passing Interface) paired with shared-memory thread-level programming via OpenMP and MapReduce frameworks.
* Hardware-Aware Engineering: Documented experience with microarchitectural optimization, loop vectorization, pointer-aliasing constraints, and manual SIMD intrinsics programming.
* Concurrency Mechanics: Deep understanding of OS internals, memory barriers, lock-free data structures, and atomics (std::atomic).
* Database Internals: Practical experience designing core database subsystems (e.g., vectorized query operators, LSM-trees, B-trees, custom buffer pools, columnar serialization frameworks and query plan optimizers).
* Strong debugging, performance tuning, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in one or more leading memory and compute monitoring/performance tools (such as Valgrind, Purify, Intel/AMD/ARM diagnostics etc.)

**Bonus Qualifications:**

* Track record contributing to open-source or work experience on proprietary distributed engines (e.g., ClickHouse, DuckDB, Doris, CockroachDB, RocksDB, ScyllaDB, or Velox).
* Experience with cloud-native distributed, elastic environments, object storage tiering (S3/GCS), or zero-copy networking.
* Experience integrating heterogeneous acceleration (NVIDIA CUDA / ROCm) into big data workloads and hybrid CPU/GPU setups.
* Vector & Graph Algorithmic experience: Experience building or modifying high-performance vector index/search engines, graph-based indices, or localized quantization frameworks.
* Functional domain awareness – CPG, Retail, Pharma verticals

**What We Offer**

* Work on the bleeding edge of data infrastructure, tackling next gen big data engineering problems to support real time querying and analytics against some of the largest data sets at high concurrency
* Challenging engineering problems - all the way from functional/data science algorithm implementations on a HPC setup to bare metal/close to OS kernel level programming involving handling of hundreds of billions of records to support real-time analytics at scale.

* Integrate a broad range of AI and ML capabilities — including natural language processing, computer vision, document intelligence, and traditional machine learning models — to build holistic, multi-modal solutions that solve complex problems.

* Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable AI architectures, ensuring alignment between technical solutions and organizational objectives.
* Contribute to the development of best practices, reusable components, and internal standards for Generative AI development, fostering a culture of innovation, quality, and responsible AI use across the organization.

Must-Have Skills
  
  

* Proven hands-on experience building and deploying Generative AI solutions, including RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and LLM fine-tuning using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or simila
* Strong proficiency in Python and experience working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face) and vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or FAISS

* Experience with fine-tuning techniques such as SFT, RLHF, LoRA, and QLoRA, along with familiarity with parameter-efficient training approaches for domain-specific model customization
* Demonstrated ability to design and deploy production-grade AI systems with robust observability, logging, and monitoring capabilities ensuring reliability and performance at scale

Good-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Exposure to multi-modal AI capabilities including computer vision, document intelligence, or speech processing integrated within broader AI/ML pipelines
* Familiarity with low-code AI agent platforms (such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Flowise, or similar) alongside the ability to build custom high-code agent implementations
* Experience working within cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, leveraging managed AI/ML services for model training, deployment, and scaling
* Knowledge of responsible AI principles, including bias detection, fairness evaluation, and compliance considerations relevant to regulated industries such as financial services
* Familiarity with MLOps practices and tools such as MLflow, Weights & Biases, or similar platforms for experiment tracking, model versioning, and deployment automation

Business Acumen, Data Preprocessing, Data Science, Innovation, Machine Learning, Market/Industry Dynamics, Predictive Modeling, Programming, Statistics

**Job Description**
  
The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
  
  
The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
  
  
This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
  
  
**Core areas of impact include:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:**
  Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:**
  Monitors live AI workloads, owns first-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:**
  Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:**
  Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:**
  Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:**
  Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.

  
  
**Qualifications**
  
**Proven Characteristics for Success**

* Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.
* Strong diagnostic instinct and the persistence to establish why a system behaved as it did.
* Comfortable working to a defined technical direction while taking full ownership of implementation.
* Surfaces ambiguity in a specification rather than proceeding on assumption.
* Data-driven approach to quality, focused on measurement rather than assertion.
* Disciplined about documentation, with an understanding of why it matters to a small technical team.
* Highly organized with an action-oriented mindset and strong written communication skills.

**Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge / Experience**
**Essential**

* Hands-on experience building with large language model APIs, including prompt engineering and retrieval or knowledge base systems. Self-directed and personal project work is considered.
* Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript, sufficient to read, modify and extend an existing codebase confidently.
* Practical experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication and handling failure conditions in systems outside the developer's control.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational data structures.
* Excellent written communication, particularly in documenting technical findings for a mixed audience.
* Legal eligibility for authorized employment within the India region.
* Fluent in verbal and written English.

**Preferred**

* Experience with a workflow automation or orchestration platform such as n8n, Make or Zapier.
* Technical exposure to a CRM or sales engagement platform, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience in software testing, quality assurance or the evaluation of AI systems.
* Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or incident diagnosis.
* Experience with knowledge management, content curation or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS.
* Experience with conversational or voice AI platforms.
* Knowledge and experience working within the EdTech sector.

**Education**

* Lead technical discovery with the Bengaluru PO/BA and US stakeholders — translating complex business requirements into well-structured, scalable Salesforce solutions before development begins

* Monitor Agentforce usage, performance, adoption, errors, and consumption to continuously improve agent effectiveness and manage platform resources
* Stay current on Salesforce Agentforce, Prompt Builder, Data 360/Data Cloud, Einstein, and Salesforce AI platform capabilities and advise on opportunities for responsible adoption

**Service Cloud**

* Build and maintain Service Cloud Flows and automation — case routing, status lifecycle management, SLA milestone tracking, notifications, and closure procedures that reduce manual effort and improve resolution time

* Integrate Service Cloud with external systems and intake channels through supported Salesforce APIs, Email-to-Case, Web-to-Case, Experience Cloud, and other appropriate integration patterns
* Build Service Cloud analytics covering case volume, resolution time, SLA compliance, queue health, trends, and operational performance

**Experience Cloud**

* Own the architecture and development of Experience Cloud sites — designing portal structures, navigation models, page layouts, and digital experiences for client-facing and internal stakeholder audiences
* Configure member profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, and guest user policies — ensuring each audience sees the appropriate data, content, and functionality

* Implement Experience Cloud integrations with external identity providers — supporting SSO, registration handlers, and authentication flows that meet security and access management standards
* Design and maintain Knowledge capabilities within Experience Cloud where appropriate
* Monitor and optimize Experience Cloud site performance, component efficiency, security, and reliability

**Data Quality & Governance**

* Own Salesforce data governance framework — defining data ownership, field-level standards, picklist governance, naming conventions, documentation requirements, and data stewardship processes
* Design and implement a comprehensive duplicate management strategy — configuring matching rules, duplicate rules, and remediation processes that maintain a clean, trusted CRM dataset at scale
* Establish and enforce data validation architecture — validation rules, required fields, formula-based alerts, Flow-driven data hygiene checks, and automated exception management
* Lead data migration and enrichment initiatives — designing field mappings, transformation logic, reconciliation procedures, and post-load validation processes
* Build data governance dashboards and exception reports — giving leadership visibility into data completeness, stale records, missing critical information, duplicates, and data quality trends
* Partner with IT security and compliance functions on Salesforce data governance — including field-level security, data classification, retention, auditability, and appropriate AI data access
* Ensure Agentforce and other AI capabilities operate against trusted, appropriately governed, and permission-aware Salesforce data

description:

Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. **What You’ll Do**

* Architect, build, and deliver custom integrations, automations, and data pipelines using Addepar's APIs, ADX (Databricks), and modern engineering tools
* Manage the team's work allocation and coordinate activities across simultaneous client engagements, ensuring results are delivered on schedule and in collaboration with cross-functional partners

* Act as a technical advisor and trusted partner to clients, proactively identifying opportunities to drive additional value

**Who You Are**

* Experience: Minimum 8+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or forward-deployed technical roles, with demonstrated experience guiding, mentoring, or leading other engineers
* Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Python with experience building production-grade applications, APIs, and data pipelines; strong understanding of REST APIs, authentication patterns, and integration architecture
* Data Platforms: Hands-on experience with Databricks, Spark, and distributed data processing frameworks; proficiency in SQL and experience working with large-scale datasets across relational and NoSQL databases
* Pipelines & Automation: Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines for complex data transformations; familiarity with AI/ML tools and experience implementing LLM-driven automation solutions
* Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of financial data domains including portfolio management, performance analytics, and multi-asset class portfolios
* Engineering Practices: Experience with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices
* Leadership: A solutions-driven, player-coach mindset — able to balance hands-on delivery with coordinating a team, providing feedback, and a commitment to growing your people-management skills

* Organization: Highly organized with attention to detail, able to prioritize and context-switch across simultaneous client engagements and deliver results that may impact schedules and costs
* Mindset: Independent, adaptable, and entrepreneurial with a strong work ethic, a bias for action, and a passion for client impact; thrives in ambiguous, fast-paced environments while maintaining high-quality standards

**What You’ll Be Doing:**
**Job Summary**
This role designs, implements and continuously improves identity and access management (IAM) capabilities across Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory and adjacent platforms, with particular focus on role-based access control (RBAC), conditional access, privileged access and identity governance. The engineer builds automation and agentic AI solutions—such as access-review and role-mining agents—to reduce manual administrative overhead and strengthen the organization’s zero-trust security posture. The engineer collaborates with security, compliance and platform teams to ensure identity controls align with company policy and applicable regulations.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Design, implement and operate IAM capabilities including RBAC, conditional access, privileged identity management (PIM), and entitlement management
* Write and maintain scripts and integrations (PowerShell, Python, Microsoft Graph API, or similar) for identity provisioning, access reviews, certification workflows and reporting
* Design, build and deploy agentic AI solutions (e.g., a role-mining agent) that analyze access patterns, recommend least privilege role assignments and automate periodic access certification
* Integrate IAM systems with adjacent technologies (endpoint management, security operations, ITSM, directory services) to support end-to-end identity lifecycle management
* Monitor and report on identity-related security anomalies and support incident response and remediation for identity-based threats
* Support audit readiness by producing and maintaining documentation of IAM design, controls, and automation
* Create, publish and communicate knowledgebase articles and standard operating procedures for IAM processes
* Act as a mentor to junior engineers and operations teams on IAM for best practices, secure coding and responsible use of AI-driven automation

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years managing or supporting identity and access management, identity governance, or related security platforms
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), RBAC design, conditional access and privileged identity management (PIM)
* Demonstrated coding/scripting ability (PowerShell, Python, Microsoft Graph API, or similar) with a track record of building identity automation, integrations and reporting tools
* Hands-on experience designing or deploying agentic AI or automation solutions for identity/access use cases (e.g., role mining, access certification, anomaly detection)
* Experience with identity protocols and standards (SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM) and identity governance/compliance frameworks
* Working knowledge of Generative AI and agentic AI concepts (LLM integration, tool/function calling, retrieval-augmented generation) as applied to identity and security operations
* Ability to write clear technical documentation

* Experience building or contributing to an internal AI agent/Center of Excellence pod, including agent design and application lifecycle management (ALM) practices

* Passion for zero-trust security with an awareness of the latest identity and AI trends

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field

* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) or Copilot Studio/agentic AI certification

General Performance Criteria
  
  
As the Sr Engineer, Identity & Access Management, you will be required to fulfill your responsibilities while meeting the following general performance criteria for this position at this level:
  
  
Expertise: You research, create proof of concepts, and introduce new methods
  
  
Communication: You guide others through problem solving whether it is a technical issue, project impediment, or conflict

Influence: You regularly make an impact to your entire team
  
  
To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person I-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.

**50 Mbps**
and the ability to set up a wired connection to their home network to ensure effective remote work. These requirements may be updated as needed by the business.

Why This Role Matters
  
  
Evolent is transforming how it builds and operates infrastructure under a refreshed Platform Engineering & Operations operating model, grounded in four principles: Architecture First, Automation by Default, Reliability is a Shared Responsibility and Golden Paths Over Custom Solutions. You will turn approved designs into provisioned, automated, and documented platforms, and you will do it transparently, through formal handoffs, Office Hours reviews, and documentation your peers can actually rely on.
  
  
**Agentic AI**
: Platform Engineering is moving toward agentic AI as a standard part of how the organization works. As agentic AI transforms the way we work, we expect our engineers to be at the forefront of that change, designing and building intelligent solutions rather than simply consuming them. This builder mentality is a core attribute we assess from the first conversation.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Provision and change infrastructure exclusively as code, so that every environment is reproducible, reviewable, and free of manual drift.
* Reverse engineer the applications and infrastructure you inherit: trace dependencies, integrations, and data flows end to end until you can explain how a system actually works.
* Design and build agentic AI solutions for platform, delivery, and operations work: identify the toil worth automating, then build, evaluate, and harden the agent that removes it.
* Build security and compliance into the delivery path: least-privilege access, secrets handling, policy-as-code guardrails, and audit evidence produced by design rather than assembled under deadline.
* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines that deliver consistent, secure, and repeatable deployments.
* Enable container-based application delivery on Docker and Kubernetes, with a focus on Azure Kubernetes Service and Azure Container Apps.
* Build reusable cloud-native infrastructure, pipelines, and self-service capabilities that support secure and scalable delivery, including AI and ML workloads.
* Develop APIs, automation scripts, and platform integrations that remove repeat manual requests from engineering teams.
* Support and guide application teams through containerization and modern deployment patterns, and debug complex issues across the application, platform, and infrastructure layers.
* Work within agile delivery practices such as Kanban, Scrumban, and sprints to plan and deliver your work transparently.

What You'll Need to Be Successful
  
  

* 5-7 years of hands-on experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or a related discipline, with demonstrated ownership of enterprise-scale cloud platforms and automation initiatives.

We are a team of passionate, curious and diverse professionals who care about each other, our work, our company and the world. We are looking for someone who combines skill in machine learning with an ability to connect with people and see the wider context for a range of business problems.

You will be responsible for assessing state-of-the-art techniques and applying them to large scale problems, mainly in the domain of NLP. To solve problems effectively, you will need to be able to build relationships and understand the business context in which we are operating. This position will suit someone who has a deep understanding of machine learning and is comfortable presenting clearly and winsomely to a non-technical audience.

NielsenIQ helps companies to meet the needs of people all over the world for food, health, hygiene, tech and durable products. Since 1923, NIQ has moved measurement forward for industries and economies across the globe. This position opens the opportunity to research and apply state-of-the-art AI/ML techniques to strategic global projects.

**Job Description**

* Develop and apply machine learning innovations to business problems with minimal technical supervision.
* Assess your own and others’ results to understand their applicability in the real world.
* Understand stakeholders’ requirements and communicate results and conclusions accurately, clearly and winsomely.
* Perform feasibility studies and analyze data to determine the most appropriate solution.
* Work on many different data challenges, always ensuring a combination of simplicity, scalability, reproducibility and maintainability within the ML solutions and source code.
* Maintain and develop data and software with high-quality standards and minimal defects.
* Collaborate with technical colleagues on the integration and deployment of ML solutions.
* Encourage team building, motivation and cultivate effective team relations. Bachelor’s degree in computer science or an equivalent numerate discipline
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or an equivalent numerate discipline

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated senior-level experience in Machine Learning and Deep Learning using Pytorch

* Ability to understand scientific papers and develop the idea into executable code
* Analytical mindset, problem solving and logical thinking capabilities
* A high level of interpersonal and presentation skills in English across cultures
* Strong ability to meet deadlines.
* Keen to work as part of a diverse team of international colleagues and in a global inclusive culture
* Python, Pytorch, Git, pandas, sklearn, huggingface
* A minimum of 3--5 years’ experience with evidence in a related ML field

**Good to Have:**

* Master's degree and/or specialization courses in ML/DL/NLP. PhD in science is   an added value.
* Experience in MLOPs
* Understanding and practice of Generative AI (prompt engineering, RAG).
* A practical grasp of databases (SQL, ElasticSearch) and Databricks
* Experience in retail, consumer, ecommerce, business, FMCG domain

* Enjoy a flexible and rewarding work environment with peer-to-peer recognition platforms.
* Recharge and revitalize with help of wellness plans made for you and your family.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
***Be part of something bigger. Decode the future.***
At Electrolux, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.
  
  
Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together.
  
  
As a key player in this transformation, you will help shape the future of our digital solutions, ensuring the highest quality and smooth execution. You will work in a fast-paced, high-energy environment within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), collaborating across multiple Agile Release Trains. The initiatives you will participate in are at the forefront of our strategic priorities, and your contributions will directly impact our success.
  
  
**All About The Role**
As a Senior Software Engineer in Test, you will take part in end-to-end test automation activities for major initiatives across multiple regions, including CRM, Contact Center, AI and Service Operations rollouts. You will support test automation solutions from development through technical go-live. The role involves interacting with senior leaders and stakeholders, ensuring alignment across teams and driving timely, high-quality test automation.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity for someone passionate about driving test automation at scale, with exposure to large-scale e-commerce, CRM and ERP systems. You will be at the heart of a dynamic environment where your ability to support test automation frameworks and scripts will be critical to success.
  
  
**About The CDI Experience Organization**
The Consumer Direct Interaction Experience Organization is a Digital Product Organization responsible for delivering technology solutions to end users and consumers across both pre-purchase and post-purchase journeys. We are organized across 15+ digital product areas, providing solutions ranging from Contact Center, E-commerce, Marketing and Identity to AI. You will play a key role in ensuring the right sizing, right skillset and core competency across these product areas.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Framework Development: Contribute to, maintain and enhance the test automation framework by adding new capabilities and improving maintainability. Ensure the framework supports scalability, modularity and cross-platform compatibility. Be ready to enter unfamiliar areas and quickly implement suitable solutions.
* Test Script Development: Design, develop and maintain robust, reusable test automation scripts. Work across UI, API, database and potentially mobile or desktop application layers. Implement and maintain utilities and test libraries. Support developers with unit tests when required.
* Test Strategy & Planning: Collaborate with QA leads and developers to define what to automate, when and how. Ensure test automation is integrated into the CI/CD pipeline and supports continuous testing.
* Test Execution & Maintenance: Run automated tests regularly and analyze results. Identify and troubleshoot failures, escalating issues when necessary. Maintain and update test cases and CI/CD pipelines as applications evolve.
* Troubleshooting & Debugging: Investigate test failures and determine root causes, whether a test issue, application defect or environment problem. Provide effective fixes or workarounds.
* Collaboration & Mentorship: Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, DevOps and product owners to align testing objectives. Mentor junior team members on automation best practices and tool usage.
* Code Quality & Version Control: Write clean, maintainable and efficient automation code. Review code from junior engineers and provide constructive feedback. Ensure adherence to coding standards and version-control practices.
* Test Data & Environment Handling: Set up or manage basic test data for automated runs. Execute tests across environments and report inconsistencies.
* Documentation: Document automated tests and provide clear test-case descriptions. Keep test coverage and automation status updated in tools such as Jira, TestRail or similar platforms.
* Experience & Expertise: Hands-on experience in at least one of the following programming languages or technologies: React.js, Next.js, .NET, Java, JavaScript, Python or Kotlin.
* API Experience: Hands-on experience testing or developing APIs.
* E-commerce Fulfilment: Desired hands-on experience testing order fulfilment for e-commerce, with a main focus on SAP Commerce (CCv2) and SAP ECC SD/MM.
* Automation & DevOps: Proven experience building test frameworks and applications, working with Git, API automation testing and microservices solutions, and setting up CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or similar. Strong experience with Docker or similar.
* Agile Methodology: Experience working in an Agile environment and comfort with dynamic settings and requirements. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and can independently drive assigned tasks forward with precision and efficiency.
* Communication & Collaboration: Proficient in cross-functional communication, with a demonstrated ability to facilitate team communication and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with modern development tools and processes, DevOps practices, cloud solutions such as Azure or AWS, Robot Framework, Selenium Grid, and reporting tools such as Grafana or ReportPortal.
* Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify opportunities for automation improvement or technical-debt reduction. Stay current with industry trends, tools and emerging practices.
* Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Where you'll be**

* This is a full-time position based in Bangalore, India.

**Benefits Highlights**

* Flexible work hours and a hybrid work environment
* Discounts on award-winning Electrolux products and services
* Family-friendly benefits
* Extensive learning opportunities and a flexible career path

title: Site Reliability Engineer

This team supports enterprise engineering platforms, including GitHub Enterprise, Jenkins, Nexus Repository Manager, HashiCorp Vault, and OpenShift, along with automation solutions built using Ansible Automation Platform (AAP), Jenkins, and Python.

The role focuses on maintaining reliable, secure, and resilient production services deployed primarily in company-hosted data centers. Responsibilities include platform administration, incident resolution, lifecycle management, and developing automation that reduces repetitive operational work.

* Support and maintain critical production engineering services, ensuring availability, stability, and recoverability.
* Investigate complex incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Manage platform upgrades, patching, configurations, and ongoing lifecycle maintenance.
* Identify and address technical debt, unsupported components, end-of-life technologies, and security vulnerabilities.
* Contribute to disaster recovery planning, resiliency improvements, and operational risk reduction.
* Participate in operational readiness reviews and onboarding of new services.
* Develop and maintain runbooks, technical documentation, and support procedures.

* Build reusable automation components and engineering tools that reduce manual effort and improve consistency.

* Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices across the team.

*Planning and Continuous Improvement*

* Identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency.
* Document proposed improvements and contribute to planning and prioritization through established team processes.
* Balance production support, project delivery, technical debt reduction, and automation initiatives according to business priorities and team capacity.
* Support platform modernization and process improvement efforts.
* Determine when processes should be automated, simplified, standardized, eliminated, or retained as manual activities.

**Required Qualifications**

*Ansible and Infrastructure Automation*

* Strong hands-on experience with Ansible Automation Platform (AAP).
* Experience creating and maintaining Ansible playbooks, roles, workflows, and reusable automation.
* Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code and configuration management practices.

* Experience integrating systems through REST APIs.

* Understanding of software design patterns, coding standards, and maintainable development practices.

* Experience administering Jenkins in an enterprise production environment.
* Hands-on experience supporting Jenkins controllers, agents, and pipelines.
* Ability to troubleshoot CI/CD platform issues and associated developer workflows.

*Kubernetes and Container Operations*

* Experience supporting Kubernetes environments and troubleshooting containerized applications.
* Understanding of Kubernetes architecture and day-to-day operations.

*Site Reliability and Production Support*

* Experience supporting production services and managing technical incidents.
* Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience improving service reliability and availability.
* Understanding of service-level agreements (SLAs), service-level objectives (SLOs), operational risk, disaster recovery, and resiliency planning.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on administration experience with one or more of the following platforms:
* Red Hat OpenShift
* GitHub Enterprise
* Nexus Repository Manager
* HashiCorp Vault
* Experience with vulnerability management, security remediation, and enterprise application support.
* Familiarity with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with platform engineering, infrastructure modernization, and Agile delivery practices.

description:

The Opportunity
  
  
Customer Experience Orchestration (CXO) is a key part of Adobe’s strategy to help enterprises deliver personalized, connected customer experiences at scale.
  
  
We are looking for an Engineering Manager to guide a high-achieving engineering group within Adobe Campaign. This position will also offer technical and personnel leadership for essential product development, guaranteeing the delivery of scalable, dependable, and high-quality customer solutions.
  
  
The Challenge
  
  
As an Engineering Manager, you will direct technical implementation, support people development, and advance strategic engineering initiatives. Key areas of responsibility include:
  
  

* Security Leadership: Own and drive Adobe Campaign’s security strategy in an evolving threat landscape developed by frontier AI models and increasingly sophisticated attack techniques. Partner with Security and Engineering teams to identify risks, prioritize remediation, and strengthen the product’s security posture. Help advance Adobe’s security practices and capabilities to address emerging AI-related risks while ensuring the continued protection of customer data and enterprise systems.
* Technical Leadership: Guide architecture and technical decisions for complex, scalable, and reliable systems.
* People Leadership: Mentor and develop engineers, support career growth, and build a high-performing team.
* Engineering Excellence: Establish high standards for software quality, reliability, performance, operational excellence, and engineering practices.
* Product Leadership: Partner with Product, Architecture, Quality Engineering, Security, and other collaborators to translate business and customer needs into effective technical solutions.

Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of software engineers.

* Deliver scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions through sound engineering methods and technical decision-making.

* Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, systems, and team practices.

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, including experience managing engineering teams.

* Strong programming experience in C++, Java, Python, or similar languages.
* Experience building scalable, reliable enterprise software.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in application security, secure software development, vulnerability management, or security engineering.

Experience with threat modelling, secure code review, source/sink/escaper taint analysis, and remediation of OWASP Top 10 and related vulnerability classes, including injection, broken authentication/authorization, CSRF, SSRF, XXE, XSS, and multi-stage pre-auth RCE chains across native C++, server-side JavaScript, web, and SOAP/REST surfaces.
  
  
**About Adobe**
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. description:

audax means courage. To have the courage to change the banking scene, eliminating constraints caused by existing legacy infrastructure. Our mission is to empower banks and financial institutions to scale and modernise at speed, reaching new customers without breaking the bank.

We are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to help build and operate reliable, scalable, cloud-native platforms supporting mission-critical financial applications. In this role, you will own the design and operation of Kubernetes/OpenShift-based environments, including multi-cluster setups, and lead reliability, observability, and infrastructure-automation practices within your platform area. You will work closely with engineering, platform, and security teams to resolve non-routine infrastructure problems, embed security into platform operations, and improve delivery velocity for the wider engineering organization.

* Design and operate Kubernetes/OpenShift environments — including multi-cluster deployments, nodes, networking, storage, ingress, and operators — within your platform scope.

* Participate in on-call rotation, troubleshoot complex platform and infrastructure issues, and lead incident response through blameless postmortems.
* Build and maintain CI/CD and GitOps pipelines (ArgoCD, Jenkins, Helm) to improve deployment reliability and developer productivity.
* Apply infrastructure security practices — RBAC, IAM, secrets management, certificates, network policies, and encryption — across managed environments.
* Partner with engineering, platform, and security teams to align on reliability priorities, provide operational guidance, and resolve non-routine infrastructure issues.
* Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides, and mentor engineers to raise platform and reliability capability across the team.

**Requirements**

* 6–9 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience operating Kubernetes/OpenShift in production, including multi-cluster environments.
* Experience managing cloud infrastructure (AWS) alongside on-prem or hybrid environments.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code tooling (Terraform, Helm) and GitOps workflows (e.g. ArgoCD).
* Experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub, or similar).
* Practical experience with observability stacks: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenSearch/ELK, and OpenTelemetry.
* Working knowledge of distributed data systems such as PostgreSQL, Kafka, or Cassandra.
* Experience implementing infrastructure security controls, including RBAC, IAM, secrets management, and network policies.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across networking, storage, and application infrastructure.
* Experience supporting production systems in financial services or another regulated industry is preferred.

* Continually review and recommend improvements to operational processes, procedures and automation.
* Pursue and recommend opportunities to automate anything and everything where possible.
* Ensure Monitoring and Alerting Standards are tested in transition and followed in production.
* Ensure migrated Cloud infrastructure solutions maintain compliance with Security and Governance standards.
* Confirm the health of the service meets defined service level expectations.
* Participate in incident management and communications, including follow-up with problem resolution post-mortem, and process improvement.
* Support automation solutions for source, deploy, pipeline, configuration management.

* Experience with DevOps related automation tools and platform management services (GCP, AWS, Azure) and Terraform and GitHub
* Systems administration expertise (Windows, Linux)
* Scripting technologies (Powershell, Bash, Python)
* Enterprise Monitoring Tools for infrastructure and applications
* ITIL Foundations
* Enterprise ITSM and CMDB Tools
* Data Networks – routing, firewalls, load balancers, DNS
* Databases
* Cloud Storage architecture and technologies
* Security – Access Management, Key Management
* Cloud Architectures
* Automation in a cloud environment – Infrastructure as Code
* SDLC and Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment concepts
* Risk, Security, and Audit compliance

* 1 Year of experience with GCP, Azure and AWS, certification desired.
* 1-2 Years of experience with Infrastructure as Code.
* 1-2 Years of experience with monitoring enterprise systems.
* 1-2 Years of experience in data center domains (server, network, storage, security)

* Security compliance experience

* Ability to apply critical thinking to all aspects of the position

title: Data Solutions Architect
description:
**Job Title**
Data Solutions Architect
  
  
**Job Description**
**So, who are we?**
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.
  
  
The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.
  
  
Join us at IG – the future gets built here!
  
  
**Your role in the Team's Success**
You will sit within Enterprise Data, reporting into the data strategy and governance function, and working closely with data and database engineering, messaging and data science teams.
  
  
Your remit is solution architecture within the enterprise data standards.
  
  
This is a role for someone who wants to design hard systems in a regulated environment with real consequence, and who is looking to grow into enterprise-level scope over time — not for someone who expects to arrive owning it.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the solution architecture and high-level design for Post Trade regulatory reporting data — from trade and lifecycle event capture on the enterprise message bus, through the lakehouse layers, to submission, acknowledgement handling and reconciliation against trade repositories.
* Design and deliver solution architecture for assigned domains on the GCP lakehouse — from event ingestion off Kafka, through Bronze/Silver/Gold, to consumption by analytics, operational and regulatory reporting workloads.
* Model the data. Dimensional and canonical modelling, conformed dimensions, slowly changing dimensions, grain determination, and the trade-off between nested and repeated structures versus normalised models in BigQuery. Design to the enterprise canonical standard — extending it through the governance forum where a domain genuinely needs something it does not cover.
* Own schema contracts in practice. Avro schema design and review; compatibility mode selection (backward, forward, full and their transitive variants) and the producer/consumer upgrade ordering each one implies; union and default-value design for evolvability; topic, key, partition and compaction design; and the operational consequences of getting any of those wrong.
* Design ingestion for both batch and streaming. Watermarks, windowing, triggers and allowed lateness for out-of-order arrival; replay and restatement; idempotency and deduplication strategy; dead-letter and poison-message handling; and honest reasoning about where exactly-once guarantees actually stop — they do not extend past the Kafka boundary to an external sink.
* Build data quality and profiling into the design — DQ gates at layer boundaries, reconciliation and break detection, completeness and accuracy controls, and the lineage and audit evidence that regulated consumers, internal audit and regulators will ask for.
* Apply the governance model. PII classification, BigQuery policy tags, column-level and row-level security, dynamic data masking, IAM/RBAC design, CMEK and key management — including the design tension where privacy obligations and multi-year regulatory retention pull in opposite directions.
* Work with infrastructure and platform engineering to specify and guide the setup of the runtimes the data architecture requires.
* Produce the artefacts and take them through review. HLDs, interface specifications, ADRs and reference designs, authored to a standard that survives formal architecture governance and your own absence from the room.
* Work across teams — with producing service teams on event contracts, with data and database engineering, messaging and data science, and with business and compliance stakeholders on what the data has to mean.
* Contribute to the architecture - design reviews, standards feedback, knowledge sharing, and mentoring engineers into architectural thinking.

**What You’ll Need For This Role**

* 10+ years in data engineering and data architecture, with hands-on delivery of cloud data solutions from design through to production, and demonstrable ownership of at least one end-to-end data solution in a regulated environment.
* Post Trade or regulatory reporting data experience. Direct delivery experience on at least one of MiFIR, EMIR (including Refit), ASIC, MAS, SFTR or CFTC reporting. Reportable-event determination, lifecycle and correction semantics, identifier management (UTI, UPI, LEI, ISIN), pairing and matching, reconciliation against trade repository acknowledgements and rejections, back-reporting, and a working grasp of what a completeness or accuracy breach actually costs to remediate.
* Deep, hands-on GCP. BigQuery is the centre of gravity: partitioning and clustering strategy, slot reservations and cost governance, authorised views and datasets, materialised views, table snapshots and time travel, the Storage Write API, policy tags, column-level and row-level security, dynamic data masking, and CMEK. Plus Cloud Composer/Airflow (idempotent task design, backfill and catch-up semantics), Dataflow or Dataproc, Datastream for change data capture, GCS, Cloud Run and Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, IAM, VPC Service Controls, and Dataplex for classification, data quality and lineage. GCP depth is what we are hiring for; breadth on other clouds is welcome but does not substitute for it.
* Medallion lakehouse design in production — Bronze/Silver/Gold with immutability at Bronze, progressive quality enforcement, deterministic reprocessing, and a defensible position on where transformation logic is allowed to live.
* Kafka at enterprise scale with a governed schema registry (Cloudera, Confluent or equivalent) — Avro schema design and evolution, compatibility modes and their operational consequences, event-driven ingestion into a cloud data platform, consumer group and lag management, compacted topics and tombstone semantics, and the ordering and delivery guarantees Kafka does and does not provide.
* Data governance in a regulated environment — IAM/RBAC frameworks, PII classification and encryption, data retention design, audit logging, and compliance-driven design under FCA, GDPR or equivalent supervision.
* Architecture artefacts that have passed formal review — HLDs, ADRs, interface specifications, reference designs. You can evaluate competing options, articulate trade-offs without hedging, decide under ambiguity, and write the decision down.
* Cloud integration patterns — REST API, MFT, event streaming, cross-cloud AWS↔GCP — including Workload Identity Federation, VPC perimeters, and JWT-based service-to-service authentication.
* Working command of core data platform concepts — data lake, ODS, data warehouse and lakehouse — and a clear view of when each is the right answer rather than a default.
* Stateful stream processing with Apache Flink or Spark Structured Streaming — state stores, checkpointing, and event-time processing at scale.
* Enough Java and event-driven / microservices fluency to review service designs and challenge engineering teams credibly. This is not a hands-on development role.
* Oracle RDBMS, PostgreSQL and MongoDB, in the context of a legacy estate still carrying business-critical data.
* dbt, Terraform or equivalent infrastructure-as-code.

**Person specification**

* A collaborator who works across IT and business teams to realise integration design and evolve the strategy jointly rather than in isolation.
* Sound, pragmatic judgement — balancing pace, risk and commercial value to reach decisions that are well informed, rigorous and actionable.
* Builds credibility and influence with stakeholders through technical substance and clear communication.
* A good facilitator — draws out problems, builds consensus, and secures commitment from the people who have to deliver.
* Curious and forward-thinking, with the appetite to grow scope over time.

**The perks**
Your growth fuels our success! Thrive with tailored development programs, mentoring opportunities with leaders, and clear career progression. Expand your network through committees, sports and social clubs. Enjoy extra time off for volunteering and community work.
  
  

* Matched giving for your fundraising activity

* Career-focused technical and leadership training in class and online, incl. unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning platform
* Contribution to gym memberships and more

* Two days’ volunteering leave per year.

McCormick & Company, Inc., a world leader in the spice, flavor and seasonings industry, is seeking a full time Cloud Security Engineer – Technology and Engineering. This position will report to the Sr. Manager Cybersecurity - Technology and Engineering.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Cloud Security Engineer is an individual contributor role focused on improving the security posture of McCormick’s cloud environments. The role will help implement and operate cloud-native security controls, identify and reduce cloud risk, and enable secure adoption of cloud services.
  
  
Working closely with cloud platform, infrastructure, DevOps, application, identity, and Security Operations teams, this engineer will support secure cloud configurations, identity and access controls, posture management, automation, and remediation of security findings.
  
  
This role is suited to a hands-on cloud security professional with strong practical knowledge of one primary cloud platform and the ability to collaborate effectively across a global organization.
  
  
This is an opportunity to help shape and mature cloud security capabilities in a global organization. The role will directly contribute to secure cloud adoption, improved visibility of cloud risk, stronger governance, and more efficient remediation through practical security automation and engineering partnerships.
  
  
**Description**
Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* Operate and improve cloud security posture management capabilities, including visibility of cloud assets, configuration risks, vulnerabilities, and policy compliance. Prioritize findings based on business impact and risk, and work with cloud and application teams to drive remediation.
* Design, implement, and maintain practical cloud security standards, guardrails, and baseline configurations for identity, networking, storage, compute, logging, encryption, and workload protection. Help prevent security drift through policy enforcement and repeatable secure configuration patterns.
* Support least-privilege access across cloud environments by identifying excessive permissions, inactive identities, risky access paths, and service-account risks. Partner with IAM and platform teams on access reviews, privileged access, and secure identity design.
* Partner with cloud platform, infrastructure, and DevOps teams to embed security controls into infrastructure-as-code and deployment workflows. Develop or enhance automation that improves control coverage, reduces manual effort, and enables timely remediation.
* Help improve cloud security monitoring, alert quality, and investigation readiness through cloud-native logging, security tooling, and integrations with the SIEM and Security Operations teams. Support investigation and remediation of significant cloud security findings, while SOC retains primary incident-response ownership.
* Provide cloud security input for new services, migrations, and significant design changes. Review proposed architectures against established patterns and identify practical controls for secure deployment, data protection, segmentation, resilience, and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain cloud security documentation, standards, exceptions, and operating procedures. Track control coverage, remediation progress, policy compliance, and key risk trends; provide concise updates to management and recommend improvements to cloud security capabilities.
* Participate in internal workshops and architecture review boards for cloud platforms.
